products.title: Hawas Sapphire
products.body_html:
Vibrant and electric, Hawas Sapphire is the ocean caught in a flash of lightning, surging with energy, uncontained and brilliant. A striking rush of crisp citrus and sharp, sun-warmed spices cuts through the air, creating a scent that is boldly magnetic, deeply refreshing, and impossible to ignore.

Inspiration

A sapphire blue wave breaking under an open sky, boundless, high voltage, and unforgettable. Hawas Sapphire embodies the thrill of a limitless horizon and the magnetic pull of pure, untamed momentum, the scent of power in motion.

products.title: Fayiz
products.body_html:
Product Overview

Fayiz is an elegantly modern and refinedly contemporary Eau de Parfum from Rasasi Perfumes, presented as a refined new launch debuted at Beauty World Dubai. A captivating composition designed for those who treat their daily fragrance as a quiet, accessible signature of personal style, Fayiz marks Rasasi's latest contemporary release that brings the brand's celebrated perfumery artistry into a fresh new expression. It is a fragrance for the wearer who treats their presence as a quiet language of distinguished taste, and who lets their refined, contemporary trail leave an unmistakably elegant impression in every room they enter.

Scent Experience

Fayiz unfolds with a softly captivating opening that wraps the wearer in an immediate aura of contemporary sophistication and refined warmth from the very first spray. As the fragrance evolves, the character settles into a beautifully balanced accord that layers freshness, elegance, and depth throughout the day, raising the scent from its initial impression to a deeply personal trail that becomes more characterful as it bonds with the skin. The drydown wraps the wearer in a quietly powerful and lingering trail of refined warmth that feels both modern and timeless. Refined, contemporary, balanced, and beautifully lasting.

Perfect For

Season: Year-round versatility, with its balanced character shining in both warm and cool weather and transitioning beautifully across the changing seasons.

Occasion: Daily luxury signature, office wear, evening events, romantic outings, special celebrations, intimate gatherings, signature wardrobe addition, and gifting for those who appreciate refined contemporary sophistication and modern Arabian perfumery elegance.

Time of Day: A perfect all-day perfume that transitions effortlessly from day into evening.

Why You Will Love It

Fayiz captures the rare quality of feeling both quietly refined and contemporarily modern at the same time, designed to deliver Rasasi's signature perfumery craftsmanship in a fresh, distinctive format. As a brand-new launch debuted at Beauty World Dubai, Fayiz represents Rasasi's continued commitment to expanding its contemporary collection with thoughtfully composed, characterful fragrances for the modern wearer. As an Eau de Parfum, just a few sprays deliver a layered experience that evolves beautifully on the skin throughout the day, becoming more personal and characterful as it settles. Crafted by Rasasi Perfumes with the heritage of a 1979 Dubai perfumery house, Fayiz extends the brand's modern collection into refined daily-wear territory, designed for those who appreciate fragrance as quiet, lasting elegance rather than statement-making bombast.

Compliment Factor

Attention Grabbing: The softly captivating opening creates an instant and refined impression that people notice from the very first moment without overwhelming the room.

Compliment Magnet: Its beautifully balanced character gives it a uniquely personal trail that people find genuinely memorable and consistently want to know more about.

Long Lasting: As an Eau de Parfum, Fayiz bonds deeply with the skin, ensuring it stays present and softly warm beautifully throughout the day and well into the night.
